newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Tat Lee Finance sees '97 conditions tough.
newsitem.headline: Tat Lee Finance sees '97 conditions tough.

text.p: Tat Lee Finance Ltd said on Monday it expected difficult trading conditions to continue into 1997, but that its performance should remain satisfactory.
"The difficult conditions experienced in 1996 are expected to continue in 1997," the company said in a note accompanying its annual results statement.
Tat Lee said demand for financing slowed during 1996, with the impact of a May 15, 1996 goverment measure to curb speculation in the residential property market hitting its core business activity.
But the company said adopting competitive strategies would help it "to perform satisfactorily during the current year".
Tat Lee reported net profit up 19.6 percent for the year to December 31, 1996 at Singapore $9.9 million.
